no_api_findings.finding: The documented standard library has no RIFF/WAVE container or PCM audio parser. std::fs::read returns raw bytes, while std::io::Read supplies bytes without interpreting WAV headers or samples. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against the valid control.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library; external crates and native system libraries are separate.
